names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 7 martie, «Sfinții Sfinţiţi Mucenici Episcopi din Cherson: Vasilevs, Evghenie, Capiton, Agatodor, Elpidie și Eterie».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 7 Μαρτίου, «Άγιοι Εφραίμ, Βασιλεύς, Ευγένιος, Αγαθόδωρος, Ελπίδιος, Καπίτων και Αιθέριος», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's first entry for the Julian 7 March on pravoslavno.rs, whose heading is „Светих седам свештеномученика Херсонских.“ and whose first sentence names the seven: „Василије, Јефрем, Евгеније, Елпидије, Агатодор, Етерије и Капитон.“ This man's own name is taken out of that list; the rank word свештеномученика and Светих are left off, and Херсонских describes the seven together and is not part of any one name, so the bare forename is all the entry gives him.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

feast.note: The life doxologia prints says he died on 21 December — «în douăzeci și una de zile ale lunii decembrie» — but that his memory is counted with the earlier bishops of Cherson who suffered on 7 March. The calendar prints him on 7 martie, and that is the day recorded.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 7 martie — «Sfinții Sfinţiţi Mucenici Episcopi din Cherson: Vasilevs, Evghenie, Capiton, Agatodor, Elpidie și Eterie»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 7ης Μαρτίου — «Άγιοι Εφραίμ, Βασιλεύς, Ευγένιος, Αγαθόδωρος, Ελπίδιος, Καπίτων και Αιθέριος»

attestations.note: All seven share one page, https://www.saint.gr/3871/saint.aspx, whose own «Ημερομηνία Εορτής» is 7 Μαρτίου and whose «Τύπος εορτής» is «Σταθερή». It says the Christians of Cherson asked Constantine the Great for another hierarch and he was sent; that the idolaters asked him for a wonder «ώστε να δουν ποια είναι η αληθινή πίστη»; that he put on his hierarchical vestments, made the sign of the Cross and went into a lit furnace, stayed there a good while and came out «αβλαβής και άφλεκτος», unharmed and unburnt; and that seeing this the idolaters were baptised. The notice ends there and says nothing of his death, so this page gives him neither a year nor a martyrdom; his distich, «Ἐπῆρε χεῖρας εἰς προσευχὴν Καπίτων, / Καὶ πρὸς Θεὸν μετῆρεν ἐξάρας πόδας», speaks of his passing without saying how.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 20.03.2026 (7. март ст. ст.) — „Светих седам свештеномученика Херсонских.“ … „Светих седам свештеномученика Херсонских: Василије, Јефрем, Евгеније, Елпидије, Агатодор, Етерије и Капитон.“

attestations.note: The day's first entry. Its heading names nobody and its first sentence names all seven, so the citation quotes the heading and the body's own naming clause, and the heading is quoted whole by each of the seven folders. This folder is the Капитон of the seven. The entry tells the furnace at Cherson, the baptism of the city, the speaking of the wonder at the Council of Nicaea — which it does not date — and the drowning in the Dnieper, and the Romanian row's existing note about a death on 21 December is neither confirmed nor contradicted by it. The stored bare form is also held by `capito-the-martyr` as its Russian form, read off another day altogether; neither entry offers a fuller form, and that fold is recorded in the run's findings.

hymns.text: Dumnezeul părinţilor noştri Care faci pururea cu noi după blândeţile Tale, nu îndepărta mila Ta de la noi; ci, pentru rugăciunile lor, în pace îndreptează viaţa noastră.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfinților Sfințiți Mucenici Efrem, episcopul Tomisului, Vasilevs, Evghenie, Agatodor, Capiton

english.text: O God of our fathers, who deal with us always according to thy gentleness: take not thy mercy away from us, but at their prayers guide our life in peace.

hymns.text: Ἐπτάριθμος σύλλογος, Ἱεραρχῶν ἱερῶν, ἀγώσιν ἀθλήσεως, τὴν Ἐκκλησίαν Χριστοῦ, ἐνθέως ἐφαίδρυναν, Εὐγένιος Βασιλεὺς τε, σὺν Ἐφραὶμ Αἰθερίω, Ἐλπίδιος καὶ Καπίτων, Ἀγαθόδωρος ἅμα. Αὐτῶν Χριστὲ ἰκεσίαις, πάντας ἐλέησαν.

source.text: saint.gr — Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος δ’, Ταχὺ προκατάλαβε, on the shared page of the seven. It names all seven and is their proper. The page's first Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος πλ. α’, is the common of martyrs and names nobody.

english.text: A company seven in number, of holy hierarchs, made glad the Church of Christ divinely by the contests of their striving — Eugene and Basileus, with Ephraim and Aetherius, Elpidius and Capito, and Agathodorus with them. At their entreaties, O Christ, have mercy upon us all.

hymns.text: Ὥσπερ ἀστέρες ἄδυτοι, τῆς νοητῆς ἐλλάμψεως, τούς ἐν νυκτί τῆς ἀπάτης καθεύδοντας, υἱούς φωτός ἐδείξατε, Εὐγένιε καί Καπίτων, Ἀγαθόδωρε Βασιλεῦ καί Αἰθέριε, Ἐφραίμ σύν Ἐλπιδίῳ, ἀθλήσαντες ὡς ἀήττητοι.

source.text: saint.gr — Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος πλ. δ’, Ὡς ἀπαρχάς τῆς φύσεως, on the shared page of the seven. It names all seven.

english.text: Like stars that never set, stars of the light the mind perceives, you showed those asleep in the night of deceit to be sons of light, O Eugene and Capito, Agathodorus, Basileus and Aetherius, Ephraim with Elpidius, having contended as men unconquered.

death.note: The Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the Julian 7 March closes the entry for the seven „Сви пострадаше почетком IV века.“ — all of them suffered at the beginning of the fourth century. It gives the century's beginning and no year, which is why the bounds are a quarter-century and not a year, and the folder carried no dates at all before this reading.
